statusDefinitions.deploy_ready: Production build exists; final verification and hosting remain.
statusDefinitions.mvp_built: Working MVP or executable system exists; launch hardening remains.
statusDefinitions.build_package: Detailed build package exists but repository/runtime must be confirmed.
statusDefinitions.in_development: Product is actively being designed or coded but is not launch-ready.
statusDefinitions.concept: Defined idea without a verified working codebase.
